data.title: 春日野穹 · 海湾遮阳伞下的白色耳机
data.description: 【海边小镇湾口·傍晚】穹穿着黑白泳装蜷坐在沙滩椅上，白色耳机线绕过长发，脚边放着喝到一半的苏打水；她把一只耳机轻轻递向镜头，夕阳让冷淡的表情显出柔和。
data.location: quiet bay near the country town
data.action: 沙滩椅上蜷坐听歌，递出另一只耳机，夕阳让冷淡表情变柔和
data.promptProse: Sora Kasugano from Yosuga no Sora wears a black-and-white swimsuit with a light cardigan, white headphones and a half-finished soda. She curls into the beach chair beneath a pale parasol, one white headphone resting over her long hair. She offers the other side of the music toward the viewer while the half-finished soda catches the sunset, her reserved expression becoming quietly warm. lavender sunset over still water.
